text:
ITEM 1 | Off-white cubes, roughly 1.5-2 cm, firm-looking with matte surface and slightly porous edges, pale cream color with faint golden tint on some pieces, sitting in a steel bowl and mixed with other ingredients; covers most of the bowl's central area, about 0.4 of the bowl's visible footprint, stacked to roughly 3 cm high | 180

ITEM 2 | Pale cream, thin irregular flakes and shreds, about 0.5-1 cm wide with ragged edges, slightly crumbly and dry-looking with matte surface, heaped in the center of the bowl over the cubes, about 2 cm high | 90

ITEM 3 | Thin shredded orange strands, about 3-5 cm long, bright orange with slight sheen, scattered among the cubes near the center and lower area, sparse coverage about 0.05 of footprint, under 1 cm high | 10

ITEM 4 | Thin purple-red onion-like slivers, pale pinkish-purple with translucent edges, long thin pieces about 3-6 cm, scattered along the lower right edge of the bowl beneath the cubes, sparse, under 1 cm high | 8
